text: A device exists toward fantasy.
A device exists toward my faults.
I nevertheless grab the incorrect union
whenever my thoughts chime.
Messages phoned, casual pairing, silence.
I purchased another orb.
I remained the identical person.
People claim it would divide the burden.
It divided my wallet, that completes it.
That finishes the entire thing.
Which device is that?
Alright, which device is that?
Portside palm laboring, starboard palms sliding.
I continually stretch toward the unit I'm lacking.
Which device is that?
All right, which device is that?
Between devices ringing, identical ancient mass.
One announces timepiece.
Someone announces twice.
Siren upon Android, I remained tardy.
Novelty never repaired me.
I spoke a memo toward myself, resembling an iPhone.
Presently I possess twin gadgets shaping my seven days.
Should I misplace one, I stay okay.
Should I misplace both, I become unshackled.
I shall not become unshackled.
Twin devices, a solitary thinking cell.
Avoid tapping twin conversations.
I will merely ruin the stanza.
Keep it active, keep it inactive.
I am nevertheless going to reload.
I possess twin devices plus zero existence.
